payload.text:
Token ledger and statusline (T3)
Real, always-visible token consumption for Spec Master sessions.
Incremental stdlib transcript JSONL reader with persisted offset, no hardcoded paths
Tokens (input/output/cache_read/cache_creation), model and estimated cost attributed to feature/phase/agent
Attribution events written to .spec-master/events.jsonl by adapter hooks
Optional stdlib OTLP/HTTP JSON receiver feeds the same ledger
metrics round schema v2 with cache/model/cost, v1 still readable
Statusline shows feature, phase, tier, tokens, cost, cache hit, context %
calibration uses real tokens when available
Unknown transcript format degrades to 0 + note, never invents counts

Harness hygiene (H1-H8)
Fix audit findings H1-H8 before optimizing.
unittest discover passes without pytest installed
Suite runs from repo root without manual pythonpath
discovery/gates detect Python stack and a test gate in this repo
Owner inference matches whole words, not substrings
Tasks without explicit depends_on are not chained serially by default
metrics record-round --append writes the row atomically
- [ ] T001 Record baseline counts (unittest: 502 run / 21 errors; pytest with flag: 631; pytest from root: 62 collection errors; `gates detect --path .`: no test gate) in specs/013-harness-hygiene/validation-report.md
- [ ] T002 [US1] Write AST-guided converter in the session scratchpad (not shipped) that wraps module-level `test_*` functions into a `unittest.TestCase`, turns `@pytest.fixture` into `_fixture_<name>` helpers and `tmp_path` into a per-test temp dir; bodies/asserts kept verbatim
- [ ] T003 [P] [US1] Convert graph modules spec-master/tests/test_graph_{blast_radius,context,drift,enrichment,health,maps,model,ontology,parser,query,resolver,store,temporal,traversal,validation}.py
- [ ] T004 [P] [US1] Convert knowledge modules spec-master/tests/test_knowledge_{manifest,model,profiles,router,validation}.py and spec-master/tests/test_traceability_graph.py
- [ ] T005 [P] [US1] Wrap unittest-invisible modules spec-master/tests/test_{context_budget,evals,runtime_contract,tool_policy}.py
- [ ] T006 [US1] Verify per-module test names before/after are identical (scratchpad script) and that no module in spec-master/tests imports pytest; run unittest discover (expect ≥ 631, OK)
- [ ] T007 [US2] Reproduce failure: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest spec-master/tests -q` → `No module named '_pathfix'` (RED)
- [ ] T008 [US2] Add path-only spec-master/tests/conftest.py (no pytest import) inserting its directory into sys.path; re-run root pytest with and without path (GREEN)
- [ ] T009 [P] [US3] Add failing tests to spec-master/tests/test_discovery.py: unittest suite in `<child>/tests` detected with `python3 -m unittest discover -s <child>/tests`; pytest-importing suite → `python3 -m pytest <dir>`; root `tests/` detected; hidden/`node_modules`/`.venv` suites ignored; dir without test files ignored; manifest repo unchanged (no `scope` key, command `pytest`)
- [ ] T010 [P] [US3] Add failing tests to spec-master/tests/test_quality_gates.py: suite stack yields blocking gate named `test (python: <scope>)`; two suites yield two distinct gate names
- [ ] T011 [US3] Implement `_scan_python_test_suites()` and the no-manifest fallback in spec-master/lib/discovery.py
- [ ] T012 [US3] Implement scope-aware gate naming in spec-master/lib/quality_gates.py; run `gates detect --path .` on this repo and preflight the returned command
- [ ] T013 [US4] Add failing tests to spec-master/tests/test_team_model.py: "Build CLI parser" not frontend-dev, "Compute capital gains report" not backend-dev, "Collect feedback" / "Write user guide" fall back to fullstack-dev, plurals ("Render dashboard screens", "Expose REST endpoints") still match, path tokens ("spec-master/lib/ui.py") match; string tasks and dict tasks without `depends_on` get `[]`; explicit `depends_on` preserved
- [ ] T014 [US4] Implement token-based `_infer_owner` and remove implicit chaining in spec-master/lib/team_model.py
- [ ] T015 [P] [US5] Add failing tests to spec-master/tests/test_metrics.py: `append_round` creates missing file (and parent dir), appends in order, refuses invalid JSON / non-list leaving file untouched, leaves no temp files; CLI `--append` twice → two rows; CLI without `--append` writes nothing; CLI on corrupt file exits 1
- [ ] T016 [US5] Implement `metrics.append_round()` in spec-master/lib/metrics.py and `--append` in spec-master/lib/cli.py
- [ ] T017 Update spec-master/PROTOCOL.md (Step 6 metrics append + workstreams no implicit chaining, Step 7 suite-detected gates) and README.md where they document the changed behaviour
- [ ] T018 Record H6 → feature 17 and H7 → feature 14 deferral in specs/013-harness-hygiene/validation-report.md
- [ ] T019 Run quality gates (unittest, pytest, gates detect + preflight, evals run, graph validate), confirm no third-party import in spec-master/lib or spec-master/tests (FR-013), and write specs/013-harness-hygiene/validation-report.md; add traceability rows

payload.decision: No ADR required: no new provider, data model, trust boundary or public contract shape change
payload.rationale: Pre-implement sensitivity hits (public_contract from 'endpoints'/'contracts', external_provider from 'third-party') are keyword false positives in tasks.md; changes are internal stdlib helpers, an additive CLI flag and a documented work-package default
alternatives: Write an ADR for the H5 depends_on default change (rejected: documented in spec Clarifications/PROTOCOL; no architectural boundary moves)
